text: Assumption: LinIf acts as a pass-through to the LIN transceiver driver — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: LinIf acts as a pass-through to the LIN transceiver driver — is this correct?
norm: linif acts as a pass through to the lin transceiver driver
assumption: LinIf acts as a pass-through to the LIN transceiver driver.
rationale: According to the specification, the return value directly reflects the result of the driver.

original.text: Annahme: Vermutlich fungiert LinIf als Durchreicher an den LIN-Transceiver-Treiber — trifft das zu?
original.assumption: Vermutlich fungiert LinIf als Durchreicher an den LIN-Transceiver-Treiber
original.rationale: Der Rückgabewert spiegelt laut Spezifikation direkt das Ergebnis des Treibers wider.
